=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:24391-24406, 32282-32294 (google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite also cites :31840-31850) | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: Both close_and_reissue arms (managed and standalone) still label the original issue `ai:closed` and close it after `close_linked_pr` leaves a held PR open (`CLOSE_LINKED_PR_HELD_PRS` is non-empty). This happens when `ai:merge-lease-wait` is added after `_stall_reissue_green_pr_guard` passes but before `close_linked_pr` fetches the PR. The only response is a `::warning::`, so the lease-waiting PR stays open next to a newly created replacement issue.
  WHY: This breaks the issue's goal of "no close, no re-issue" while the PR is waiting for the merge lease, and recovery then needs a manual reopen, as in the #9398 incident. Reviewers disagreed on severity, and the highest is used. minimax_minimax-m3 and openai_gpt-6-luna rated it MAJOR. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash rated it NIT because the window lasts only seconds, the PR itself is never closed, and the behaviour predates the last run. google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite gave no severity.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:24391-24406 (managed) and 32282-32292 (standalone); close-link path around 24536-24542 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: When a held PR is left open after the guard passed, the only error path is the `::warning::` line. No `STALL_SKIP` line is logged, `STALL_RECOVERY_EFFECTIVE_ACTION` is not set to a refused variant, there is no early `return`/`continue`, and the label change on the original issue runs unconditionally.
  WHY: Operators and downstream `STALL_SKIP` greps cannot find a `close_and_reissue_refused` marker for this case, so post-merge self-heal surfaces never trip.
- tests/test_stall_reissue_green_pr_guard.py:482-543, 527-587 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: No test covers the TOCTOU window, i.e. a label that appears between the guard and `close_linked_pr`. Nor does any test assert that no `issue create` / `ai:closed` / `issue close` follows the warning.
  WHY: A future change that reorders the guard or removes the re-check would still pass CI, and the orphaned-PR regression would land silently.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:21499-21575 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: `close_linked_pr` gains an optional third argument `[stall_minutes]` that defaults to `0`. Its doc comment does not warn that leaving the argument out disables the read-error / no-event lapse backstops.
  WHY: A future two-argument caller would get an unbounded lease hold, with a risk of parking the issue permanently. The tests only lock the six existing call sites, not the function's contract.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "Stall recovery takes no action (no judge, no review dispatch, no close, no re-issue) while the implementation PR is open and waiting for the merge lease." (Issue #9892, Goal 2)
  expected_change_site: The two `close_and_reissue` arms in `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh` (managed `execute_stall_recovery_action` reissue branch at ~24386-24406, standalone ladder reissue branch at ~32282-32292, plus the review-blocked judge arm at ~38955-38972)
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: The post-`close_linked_pr` branch never checks `CLOSE_LINKED_PR_HELD_PRS` and has no abort. It has no `return 1` / `continue` and does not set `STALL_RECOVERY_EFFECTIVE_ACTION="close_and_reissue_refused"`. Execution continues into `ensure_label_exists "ai:closed"` and the `gh issue edit` that removes the active labels, in both the managed and standalone arms. The review-blocked arm's guard passes `"0"`, so the re-check after `close_linked_pr` is the only protection there.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:managed close_and_reissue arm, lines 24394-24406 (`close_linked_pr "${issue_num}" "${_stall_reissue_close_msg}" "${stall_minutes}"`, then the new `::warning::` block, then `gh issue edit ... --add-label 'ai:closed'` and `gh issue close`). The standalone arm has the same shape at lines 32285-32294. | severity=NIT | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: `_stall_reissue_green_pr_guard` runs before the replacement issue is created. If the PR gains `ai:merge-lease-wait` before `close_linked_pr` runs its own hold check, the PR is left open. The arm still closes the original issue and labels it `ai:closed`, and the new warning only makes this visible.
  WHY: The result is an open, lease-waiting PR whose issue is closed and has a duplicate replacement, a milder form of the #9398/#9885 duplicate. The reviewer rated it low because the window is seconds long (CI must finish and the lease label be applied inside it) and the PR itself is never closed.
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:execute_stall_recovery_action (:24391-24401, :32282-32292) and the standalone ladder's re-issue arm (:31840-31850) | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The close_and_reissue paths still close the original issue and label it `ai:closed` when `close_linked_pr` skips a held PR (draft, `[skip ai]` title, or merge-lease wait).
  WHY: The original PR stays open and unmerged while the issue is closed and reissued. This violates the requirement that stall recovery take no action while the PR is held, because the code assumes a successful `close_linked_pr` call means the PR was closed.
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:24391-24406 (managed reissue) and 32282-32292 (standalone reissue); guard entry at 23583-23593 and 31567-31574 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `ai:merge-lease-wait` can be applied between the guard passing and `close_linked_pr`, after `surface_reissue_closed_without_pr` has already created the replacement issue. The code then only logs a `::warning::` and goes on to `ensure_label_exists "ai:closed"` and `gh issue edit`, leaving the green PR orphaned.
  WHY: The extra API round trips in `surface_reissue_closed_without_pr` widen the window for concurrent labelers. The spec requires "no judge, no review dispatch, no close, no re-issue" while the PR is lease-waiting.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:24391-24406 and 32282-32292 (the two close_and_reissue arms that call `surface_reissue_closed_without_pr` followed by `close_linked_pr`) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: This is the TOCTOU window behind the finding above. The guard reads a snapshot, and a label added later puts the path in the warning-only branch without re-running the guard.
  WHY: There is no idempotency sentinel. Once the original issue is closed and a replacement exists, only a manual reopen fixes it, as in the 2026-11-21 #9398 incident.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:24391-24406 (managed) and 32282-32292 (standalone); close-link path around 24536-24542 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The `::warning::` is the only error path. No `STALL_SKIP` is logged, no refused `STALL_RECOVERY_EFFECTIVE_ACTION` is set, there is no early return/continue, and the label change on the original issue runs unconditionally.
  WHY: Without a `close_and_reissue_refused` marker, downstream `STALL_SKIP` greps and self-heal surfaces miss this case, and operators must correlate the warning by hand.
- tests/test_stall_reissue_green_pr_guard.py:482-543 (`test_close_linked_pr_keeps_lease_waiting_pr_open`) and 527-587 (`test_replay_2026_11_21_issue_9398_keeps_pr_9402_open`) | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: Neither test injects the label after the guard returns, and neither asserts that no `issue create` / `ai:closed` / `issue close` follows the warning.
  WHY: A future change that reorders the guard or removes the re-check would still pass CI.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:21499-21575 (`close_linked_pr` signature change) | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The new optional third argument `[stall_minutes]` defaults to `0`, and the doc comment does not warn that leaving it out disables the read-error / no-event backstops.
  WHY: A future two-argument caller gets an unbounded lease hold and a risk of parking the issue permanently. The tests only cover the six existing call sites.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: "Stall recovery takes no action (no judge, no review dispatch, no close, no re-issue) while the implementation PR is open and waiting for the merge lease." (Issue #9892, Goal 2)
  Expected change site: The two `close_and_reissue` arms in `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh` (managed `execute_stall_recovery_action` reissue branch at ~24386-24406, standalone ladder reissue branch at ~32282-32292, plus the review-blocked judge arm at ~38955-38972)
  Evidence of absence: The code adds the `::warning::` but does not abort when `CLOSE_LINKED_PR_HELD_PRS` is set. It has no `return 1` / `continue` and does not set `STALL_RECOVERY_EFFECTIVE_ACTION="close_and_reissue_refused"`, and it still runs `ensure_label_exists "ai:closed"` and `gh issue edit`. The same gap exists in the standalone ladder. In the review-blocked arm the guard passes `"0"`.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:24394-24406 and 32285-32294; close_linked_pr records held PRs at 21570-21575. | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: If the merge-lease label is added after the guard passes at 23583 but before `close_linked_pr` fetches the PR, `close_linked_pr` skips the PR and records it as held. Both reissue paths only emit a warning and still label and close the original issue.
  WHY: The merge-lease workflow can add the label asynchronously, so stall recovery closes the issue while its PR is still waiting for the lease.
=== END FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===

=== FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_3-flash ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:32283-32294 (standalone reissue) and 24391-24406 (managed reissue); close_linked_pr hold check at 21570 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: If `ai:merge-lease-wait` lands between the guard and the payload fetch in `close_linked_pr`, the PR is skipped but both reissue paths only log `::warning::` and still label the issue `ai:closed` and close it. The reviewer says this behaviour predates the last run and that the code comments accept it as residual. It also notes that the pre-replacement re-checks at 24307/32249 use the one-argument form, while the earlier guard covers that phase.
  WHY: Inside the narrow window a duplicate replacement issue is created while the PR is still lease-waiting, which breaks goal 2. The costly outcome, closing the green PR, is still prevented.
=== END FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_3-flash ===
